Rapid volume increase following the 2022 drought low. Confirmed by the project team (Simão Freitas): not natural rainfall recovery. Rabagão receives water piped from a smaller support reservoir further north ('transvase'), used to regulate energy production and prevent excess drawdown. Volume/trend readings in this window should not be interpreted as a natural drought-recovery signal.
